question: How do I disable Vale checking for a specific section of text in an MDX file?
ground_truth: To disable Vale checking in an MDX file, wrap the Vale HTML-style comment within an MDX-styled comment like this: `{{/* <!-- vale off --> */}}`. To re-enable Vale checking, use `{{/* <!-- vale on --> */}}`.

metadata.cited_context:
To use Vale's HTML-style comments (`<!-- comment -->`) in an MDX file, wrap within an MDX-styled comment (`{{/* comment */}}`). For example:
- **disable Vale**: `{{/* <!-- vale off --> */}}`
- **enable Vale**: `{{/* <!-- vale on --> */}}`
